title: Claim
description: An atomic claim extracted from the report. claim_id = sha256(section_id + normalized_text)[:16].

section_id.description: Kebab-case slug of the scope.md sub-question the claim answers (general if none)

claim_type.description: Only factual claims hard-fail on lack of support

cited_source_ids.description: Stable source_ids cited for this claim

evidence_ids.description: Evidence rows that support this claim

support_status.description: How well the evidence supports the claim, set during Phase 5 verification

supersedes.description: Optional: claim_id of the row this correction supersedes. Stores are append-only — a correction is a re-appended row naming the row it replaces.
